newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy grows 7.7 pct in Oct - Imacec index.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy grows 7.7 pct in Oct - Imacec index.

text.p: Chile's monthly Imacec index of economic activity showed the economy grew a stronger than expected 7.7 percent in October, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
The index showed growth in October at it highest level since April when the economy expanded 8.1 percent.
Economic activity speeded up sharply in October compared with five percent reported in September and 5.5 percent in August.
The index is widely regarded as a rough guide to the expansion of Chile's gross domestic product.
